title: Fail-loud font guard is dead code: load failure returns rl.GetFontDefault() which passes rl.IsFontValid, so app + harness silently run on the raylib default
detail: Missing/corrupt assets/fonts/*.ttf -> font_load_data returns nil -> font_from_glyphs returns GetFontDefault -> IsFontValid is true (default font fully initialized post-InitWindow) -> the refusal guards never fire -> silent raylib-default rendering/capture, the exact 'silent-fallback lie' lens-guard (c) requires be impossible.
recommended_fix: Propagate failure instead of substituting: make load_font_file/font_from_glyphs return (Font, bool) with ok=false on nil glyphs/atlas (return zero Font{}, never GetFontDefault) so the main.odin:317 and goldens.odin:76 guards actually exit(2).

title: glyph_probe indexes f.glyphs[i] by requested-codepoint index, but raylib compacts the glyph array — out-of-bounds read + garbage U+26A0 verdict on any font missing a probe codepoint
evidence:
harness/font_check.odin — `n := build_probe_set(&cps)` (96 codepoints: ASCII 32-126 + 0x26A0), `f := rl.LoadFontEx(..., &cps[0], c.int(n))`, then `for i in 0..<n {
		cp := cps[i]
		g := f.glyphs[i]
		present := g.advanceX > 0 || (g.image.width > 0 && g.image.height > 0)`. Vendored raylib tools/raylib-sw/src/src/rtext.c (LoadFontData): `for (int i = 0, index; i < codepointCount; i++) { index = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(&fontInfo, requiredCodepoints[i]); if (index > 0) glyphCounter++; }` then `glyphs = (GlyphInfo *)RL_CALLOC(glyphCounter, sizeof(GlyphInfo));` and glyphs[k] filled only `if (index > 0)` — missing codepoints are skipped and the allocation is sized to the FOUND count.
detail: For a candidate lacking any of the 96 probe codepoints — including the shipped IBM Plex Sans, which lacks U+26A0 per font_test.odin's negative control — glyphCount=95 and the loop reads f.glyphs[95], one element past the CALLOC'd block; the printed U+26A0 verdict uses out-of-bounds memory (present= can read true). A mid-range miss also shifts every later verdict line onto the wrong codepoint.
recommended_fix: Look glyphs up by value, not index: scan f.glyphs[0..<f.glyphCount] matching .value == cps[i] (the pattern font_probe_warning in app/render/font_test.odin already uses) and print present=false when no entry matches.

title: noc_e2e TakeScreenshot reordered BEFORE rl.EndDrawing() in PP_DEBUG builds; added comment falsely claims the block runs after the flush
evidence: app/main.odin — the noc_e2e block (lines 676-688: `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) { if app.noc_e2e { switch app.noc_e2e_frame { case NOC_E2E_CAPTURE_ON: rl.TakeScreenshot("bin/noc-e2e-on.png") ... if app.noc_e2e_frame >= NOC_E2E_EXIT { break } } } }`) now precedes the frame end (lines 691-698: `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) { rl.EndDrawing()\n\t\tif gallery_frame(&app) { break } } else { rl.EndDrawing() }`). The diff deleted the standalone `-\t\trl.EndDrawing()` that previously sat before this block. The new comment (672-675) claims `The frame's END is explicit below ... so this block runs after the flush in both.` — it runs BEFORE the flush. Upstream raylib 5.5 rcore.c TakeScreenshot (verified from the 5.5 tag): `unsigned char *imgData = rlReadScreenPixels(...)` with no rlDrawRenderBatchActive() flush; the vendored 6.0 fork's TakeScreenshot (tools/raylib-sw/src/src/rcore.c) likewise calls rlReadScreenPixels without flushing.
detail: The pre-existing comment documents why capture must follow EndDrawing: 'a mid-frame TakeScreenshot can miss the unflushed rlgl batch on the GPU build'. The reorder reintroduces exactly that path — the on/off e2e captures can read the previously presented frame. The `break` at noc_e2e_frame >= NOC_E2E_EXIT now also exits the loop with the final frame's BeginDrawing never matched by EndDrawing.
recommended_fix: Restore one EndDrawing before the noc_e2e capture block (or move the captures after the new end block) so PP_DEBUG builds flush before TakeScreenshot; fix the comment to match the actual order.

title: Gallery stage machine polls unbounded: Draw_Release/Select_Release/Noc/Deselect/Settings reset gallery.wait forever with no retry cap when a scripted event never lands
detail: If any scripted input misses (pipe never commits, midpoint click misses, overlay/stats never validate, ESC deselect never lands, settings never opens), the capture run spins indefinitely with no timeout or abort. PP_DEBUG tooling, so impact is a hung capture run, not shipped behavior.
recommended_fix: Add a per-stage retry budget (e.g. poll_ticks > N -> eprintf + gallery.done=true / non-zero exit) so a failed script precondition terminates the run loudly instead of polling forever.

title: font_merge_fallback never frees the fallback font's glyph array block (fg) after copying it into the merged array
detail: The fallback merge runs on every launch (Plex lacks U+26A0, so missing_n>=1 for each of the 3 family loads), leaking missing_n * sizeof(GlyphInfo) per family — tiny and init-time only, but it contradicts the block's own ownership comment ('freed exactly once, by UnloadFont, via the merged array' covers image data, not the fg array block).
recommended_fix: After copying fg[j] into merged, call rl.MemFree(fg) (the array block only — image data ownership moves with the copied structs to UnloadFont via the merged array).
